crossRefs.note: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
crossRefs.keyword: Kibroth-hattaavah. that is, the graves of lust

crossRefs.note: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked Yahweh to wrath.
crossRefs.keyword: Kibroth-hattaavah. that is, the graves of lust

crossRefs.note: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

people.name: Kibroth-hattaavah
people.line: A place where the Israelites complained and were punished

translations.web: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.
translations.bsb: So they called that place Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.
translations.kjv: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
translations.asv: And the name of that place was called Kibrothhattaavah, because there they buried the people that lusted.
